resource: Invitations of one private chat channel
allocation_impact: Checked under the Channel chat lock before an invitation is stored; the in-memory list never grows past it.
notes: Canary PrivateChatChannel::invitePlayer (src/creatures/interactions/chat.cpp:42 at 47dfd51f) bounds invitations only by online players; Oteryn fixes its own bound. A 17th invitation answers REJECTED and changes nothing.
